blocks.html:
Vehicle Decals – Smart Car ForTwo

Vinyl Decals are custom stickers that are designed the way you want them to look. You have full control over the size, shape, design, material, and finish. So you literally can get anything in the form of decals. Vinyl Wrap Toronto recently wrapped an entire RV with a custom-designed vinyl wrap. The couple who owned the RV was so satisfied with the job we did that they decided to get decals on their Smart Car ForTwo as well. You can check the blog for the RV here.

The inspiration behind getting the smart car done was that they wanted to reflect the same design that they got for their RV on their Smart Car ForTwo. Originally, what they wanted was to get a full wrap for the car, but later on, they decided that they wanted to go with minimal decals instead. The idea was to get wavy blue decals on the sides and a “Discovery” sticker on the back. We had an issue with the original wave design so had to adjust. When this happens our team comes together to ensure the customer is happy.

Considering decals are easier to install as compared to full or partial wraps, it didn’t take our team long to get the job done. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we have experienced installers working with us to make sure every vehicle gets wrapped with absolute perfection and precision. Just like all the other jobs we’ve done, this one turned out to be exactly what the clients wanted. The reactions we receive from our clients are more than enough for us to know that we’ve done the job right.

We’ve attached some images of the Smart Car ForTwo for you to see how a couple of vehicle decals can make your car pop.

Vinyl Decals are a great idea if you’re looking to upgrade the look of your vehicle without breaking the bank. Here are some of the perks of getting decals as compared to any other means of vehicle modification:

  1. Vehicle Decals are relatively cost-effective, considering their lifespan and low maintenance.
  2. Vehicle Decals have been proven to be an effective way to promote your business.
  3. You get full freedom to get any design you want in any colour, shape, size, and finish.
  4. Decals are easy to install and remove (by professionals)

If you have any questions/concerns or would like a quote, please feel free to reach out to us at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4. We’d love to have you over for a tour. Check out more car decals here.
